Method of Attack: Hijacking routers using a custom modified version of Mirai IoT malware to control devices for DDoS botnet
Coding and selling malware used to hack US government agencies
Impacted Systems: UK ISPs routers including UK Postal Office, TalkTalk, and Kcom
Attack Vector: Hijacking routers via domains registered by hacker
Date of Discovery: Early September 2016 (Mirai IoT malware spotted online)
Early November 2016 (BestBuy starts advertising DDoS-for-hire services)
Late November 2016 (Mirai malware causes Deutsche Telekom routers outage)
Early December 2016 (Mirai malware causes UK routers outage)
